The '''''Remember Alderaan''''' was a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
The [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]] was said to be a new ship at the time of the [[Battle of Mindor]], and was under the command of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. It arrived later to the battle over [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] than the main [[Rapid Response Task Force]] sent by the New Republic.
